Name: Vintage Interface v1
Author: ManaKirel
Description:
[center][b][color=#f4cccc][font=Georgia]
[size=2][color=#e06666][b][size=2][b][size=4][size=3]As of June 5, 2022, Maythorn will no longer be maintaining this mod. Please contact the original author, Manakirel, if you would like to take over. Posts and bug reports will be disabled until a new maintainer is assigned or Manakirel unlocks them. Thank you for all the support![/size][/size][/b] [/size][/b][/color]

Feel free to use my mods and their assets as a base or as part of a new mod (no permission needed)[/size]
[size=2]But please... [/size][u]give credit [/u][size=2]when you post your work as a public mod here or anywhere else.[/size]
[size=2]Thank you so much and enjoy this wonderful game[/size][/font]. [size=4]♥
[/size][/color][/b]

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
As requested on tumblr, here is my interface recolor!
I created it to match the desaturated mods I'm using.
Heavily inspired by [color=#ea9999][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/832/?]Kimberly's pink interface[/url][/color].
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -


[b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5]＊ About [/size][b][font=Georgia][size=5]＊[/size]
[/font][/b][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Georgia]This mod replaces the complete interface with a cream colored one. 
[/font]I wanted to create a matching interface for all the lovely classy/victorian/vintage mods out there! [font=Georgia]
Recolored versions of the mail letter background, community center bundle and billboard are also included!
It's also suitable for every desaturated Stardew Valley in general.

[img]https://78.media.tumblr.com/86004e9fc079c8dee4cde5c8f8cfde15/tumblr_orllygPm641vtegsso6_r1_1280.png[/img]﻿
[b][size=4][color=#ffe599]
☆[/color][color=#f4cccc] [/color]～[color=#f4cccc] Version 1.3 for Stardew Valley multiplayer! [/color]～[color=#f4cccc] [/color][color=#ffe599]☆[/color][/size][/b]

Compatible with the following mods:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/599/?]Just a new map recolour[/url] by Eemie
[/font]﻿[font=Georgia][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1573]A toned down Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ by LavenderLight
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2030]Flower Valley - Town and Farm Buildings ReDesign[/url]﻿ by KAYA / jina2ya[color=#f4cccc]
[/color][color=#f4cccc][size=1]* ~ Permission to use some parts of each mod is granted by the authors ! Thank you ~ *[/size][/color]

If you're still experiencing any issues with your game (red snow or green water for example) it means that your cursors file isn't updated and broken.
Please make sure to use the version I included here to get the full interface as well.


I've made my own animated dig spot replacer! It's a cute little flower which is already included and [b][color=#e06666]red[/color][/b] by default. I hope you like it! [b][color=#f4cccc][size=4]♥
[/size]New:[/color][/b] Now also available as a standalone mod for [i]Content Patcher,[/i] if you prefer the dig spot without my interface recolor~
(For the [color=#f4cccc][b]pink[/b] [/color]variant, please download the pink standalone version and erase the red one from the cursors.png file of my main mod.)


[b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5]＊ Installation [/size][b][font=Georgia][size=5]＊[/size]
[/font][/b][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=4]＊[/size][/color][/font]You need the latest [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ version to use my mod. Please download and install them first, then move on to the next step!
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=4]＊[/size][/color][/font]Download my main file and (if you're using the manual installation method) place it in [i]Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/i].A config file to enable/disable the Flower Valley compatibility will be created after you run the game.
For compatibility with other mods, check the "compatibility patches" folder. You can use these files to overwrite the images in the relevant mods.
[/font][/center][center][font=Georgia][font=Georgia]

[b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5]＊ Updates [/size][b][size=5]＊[/size]
[/b][/color][/font][/b][b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][b]
[/b][/color][/font][/b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]01.11.22 [/color][/font][font=Georgia][size=1]//[/size][/font][b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][b] [/b][/color][/font][/b]Added compatibility for android.
Completed translations and merged them into a single mod.
Added more digspot colors and included several new files.
Many textures were lightly desaturated to match the mod's theme better.
Created more config options to help increase compatibility with other mods.[b][font=Georgia][b]
[/b][/font][/b][/font]
[color=#f4cccc]22.01.19[/color][size=1] //[/size] Removed the XNB version of my mod and updated the CP version. Please let me know if you're still having any issues! 
Thank you @ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/22424444]Pyroette[/url] for the billboard fix and also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33334665]dreamsicl[/url] for readding and fixing my custom font color! [b][color=#f4cccc][size=4]♥[/size][/color][/b]

[color=#f4cccc]13.06.18[/color][size=1] //[/size] The flower dig spot is now available as a standalone mod for [b]Content Patcher[/b]! (Thank you once more for making the CP file, [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/paradigmnomad.925472/]Paradigmnomad[/url]!)

[color=#f4cccc]09.06.18[/color][size=1] //[/size] [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/paradigmnomad.925472/]Paradigmnomad[/url] was so kind to convert my mod into a [b]Content Patcher[/b] version! Thank you so much! ♥

[color=#f4cccc]18.05.18[/color][size=1] //[/size][color=#f4cccc] [/color][b]V 1.3[/b] for SV multiplayer beta is now available! Please update your files by overwriting the old ones!
Added a custom flower dig spot, tweaked the border colors of my interface a little

[color=#f4cccc]07.10.17[/color][size=1] //[/size][color=#f4cccc] [/color]Finally added a matching billboard! Just drop the .xnb (optional files) into [i]Stardew Valley\Content\LooseSprites.[/i]

[color=#f4cccc]17.07.17[/color][size=1] //[/size][color=#f4cccc] [/color]Reuploaded the main file just for the fixed cursors.xnb for vanilla map colours. It probably had the older one with the annoying snow bug in it.

[color=#f4cccc]21.06.17[/color][size=1] //[/size][color=#f4cccc] [/color]Fixed the [i]cursors.xnb[/i] for both files with a newer xnb-node so this time it'll probably be without any bugged snow and green water issues.
I tested it with a save file in winter so it should be working properly now.[/font][font=Georgia]
[/font][/center]
